messages.subject: with and without including "mimic="mplus""
parts:
* NOTE: The previous post was deleted due to typos in the message.


Hi Yves,

I am trying to model a quite complex model, and I find that the model converge only when mimic = "mplus" is added. I find it quite strange and I cannot explain why. I am not sure why and am now reporting this issue.

The syntax is as follow:

model.1 = "

construct1 =~ NA*Q10+Q20+Q30+Q40+Q50+Q5+Q15+Q25+Q35+Q45
construct2 =~ NA*Q2+Q12+Q22+Q32+Q42+Q7+Q17+Q27+Q37+Q47
construct3 =~ NA*Q4+Q14+Q24+Q34+Q44+Q9+Q19+Q29+Q39+Q49
construct4 =~ NA*op1+op4+op5+op7+op2+op3+op6

style_1 =~ 1*Q10+1*Q20+1*+Q30+1*Q40+1*Q50+1*Q5+1*Q15+1*Q25+1*Q35+1*Q45
style_2 =~ 1*Q2+1*Q12+1*Q22+1*Q32+1*Q42+1*Q7+1*Q17+1*Q27+1*Q37+1*Q47
style_3 =~ 1*Q4+1*Q14+1*Q24+1*Q34+1*Q44+1*Q9+1*Q19+1*Q29+1*Q39+1*Q49
style_4 =~ 1*op1+1*op4+1*op5+1*op7+1*op2+1*op3+1*op6

style_overall =~ 1*style_1+style_2+style_3+style_4

external_fs =~ 1*external72a+external72b+external72c+external72d

construct1 ~~ 1*construct1
construct2 ~~ 1*construct2
construct3 ~~ 1*construct3
construct4 ~~ 1*construct4

external_fs ~~ 0*style_1+0*style_2+0*style_3+0*style_4

style_1 ~~ 0*construct1 + 0*construct2 + 0*construct3 + 0*construct4
style_2 ~~ 0*construct1 + 0*construct2 + 0*construct3 + 0*construct4
style_3 ~~ 0*construct1 + 0*construct2 + 0*construct3 + 0*construct4
style_4 ~~ 0*construct1 + 0*construct2 + 0*construct3 + 0*construct4

style_overall ~~ 0*construct1 + 0*construct2 + 0*construct3 + 0*construct4
"

test.model = cfa(
  model.1, data = dataset, estimator = "MLR", test = "Satorra.Bentler", mimic = "mplus"
)

I am using lavaan version 0.5-16. I have also used mplus and found consistency in terms of parameter values between lavaan and mplus, when mimic = "mplus"

Thank you,
Chester Kam
